<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.75; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 12pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold"><a name="DocsID"><!--EFPlaceholder--></a><font style="FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 12pt">&#8234;ArcelorMittal publishes a Technical Information Memorandum regarding the listing of Aperam</font></font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.75; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.75; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Luxembourg, 12 January 2011 (16:15 CET)&#160;&#160;- With reference to the European listing prospectus of 15 December 2010 relating to the spin-off of ArcelorMittal&#8217;s stainless and specialty steels business into Aperam, a Technical Information Memorandum has been published today that provides information on the listing timetable. The memorandum is available on ArcelorMittal&#8217;s website under &#8220;Investors &amp; Shareholders &#8211; Extraordinary General Meeting 25 January 2011&#8221;.</font></div>
